# --instructions--

Write a function `nameOf(enumObj, value)` that returns the name of the member of `enumObj` holding `value`, or `undefined` if no member holds it

# --before-seed--

```javascript

const tryCatch = (...args) => {
  _testCount++
  try { assert(...args) }
  catch (e) {
    _testFailedCount++
    console.log(`Test Case '--err-t${_testCount}--' failed`);
  }
};
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --seed--

```javascript
function nameOf(enumObj, value) {

}
```

# --asserts--

`nameOf({ LOW: 1, HIGH: 3 }, 3)` must return `"HIGH"`.

```javascript
tryCatch(nameOf(Object.freeze({ LOW: 1, HIGH: 3 }), 3) === "HIGH");
```

`nameOf({ RED: "red", BLUE: "blue" }, "red")` must return `"RED"`.

```javascript
tryCatch(nameOf(Object.freeze({ RED: "red", BLUE: "blue" }), "red") === "RED");
```

`nameOf({ LOW: 1, HIGH: 3 }, 2)` must return `undefined`.

```javascript
tryCatch(nameOf(Object.freeze({ LOW: 1, HIGH: 3 }), 2) === undefined);
```

`nameOf({ ONE: 1 }, "1")` must return `undefined`, because the string `"1"` is not the number `1`.

```javascript
tryCatch(nameOf(Object.freeze({ ONE: 1 }), "1") === undefined);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function nameOf(enumObj, value) {
  return Object.keys(enumObj).find((key) => enumObj[key] === value);
}
```
